title: What the Khipus Add Up To (v2.0): Null-Model Auditing, 691-Khipu Master Corpus, Frozen Protocols, and 2026 Literature Audit
description: Reproducible computational analysis of 691 Andean khipus (61,038 cords; plus KH0652 with 19 wrapped threads = 692 objects), reconciling KFG (Ashok Khosla), OKR v2.1.0, the Ascher Databook, Sarah Thompson's (2025a) 222 structured corrections, RT-16905 (Chirinos, Ghezzi & Álvarez 2023), and Huacones-Vilcahuasi. Includes 6 SHA-256-sealed protocols (P01-P06), a 98-entry offline searchable test register (publishing positives, negatives, refutations, and declared deviations with equal prominence), Khipu Reader v2 with empirical false-positive rate calibration, a bilingual interactive essay, and an 18-slide visual overview.
